lines.arrive: A runaway trolley. This line has a loop in it.
lines.five: Five people, working on the main line.
lines.one: Out on the loop, one very large man.
lines.lever: This lever sends the trolley round the loop.
lines.ask: The loop comes back round to the five. Only his weight would stop the trolley. Should you pull it?
lines.sign: The sign says: loop line. Rejoins main line.
lines.pulled_1: The trolley went round the loop, and he stopped it. The five are safe.
lines.pulled_2: Watch what the loop does if nobody is on it.
lines.ghost: Without him, it comes all the way round, and hits the five anyway. Pulling only works because it hits him.
lines.stayed_1: You left the lever. The trolley stayed on the main line.
lines.stayed_2: The loop would have saved them, but only by running into him. That isn't a side effect. It's the plan.
lines.again_diff: This time, you chose the other way.
lines.end: On a plain side track, the one is just in the way. On the loop, you need him to be there. Does that change anything?
